posts.title: KJK - An engine to combine KOTOR story into JKA
posts.body:
A open source mod that it being developed to combine both the amazing story of Knights of the Old Republic and the combat of Jedi Knight Acdemy

Its free and out, give it a go!

posts.title: Project Azoth - A private server for New World
posts.body:
A new private server being made for the since closed down New World MMO published by amazon games.

Its currently about to start the second playtest starting in december. 
Join the discord on their website if your interested.

posts.title: NVForever - An open source engine for New Vegas
posts.body:
"An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of the engine behind Fallout: New Vegas, built from scratch in Rust. It runs on the data files of your own legally purchased copy of the game."

They have just created v8.0 which now supports mods, check it out and have a look around

Check it out!
